desc: Implement prefix-function computation in O(n) time for a string of length up to 500,000.
Build `reverse(S) + '#' + S` using a separator not present in uppercase English letters.
Use the final prefix-function value to obtain the longest palindromic suffix length.
Append `reverse(S[:n-L])` to `S` and print the result.
Ensure input/output handling is efficient and the total memory usage is linear.
